lite.homeLast: You looked at {{feature}}. Tap to see what it does for you.

schedule.default: See today's queue and appointments, and check patients in, from your phone.
schedule.doctor: Know who is next and who is waiting before you walk to the room.
schedule.frontdesk: Check patients in and see the live queue without going back to the desk.
schedule.manager: See how the day is running across your clinics at a glance.

patients.default: Look up a patient summary, allergies and current medications in seconds.
patients.nurse: Check allergies and current medications at the bedside before you give anything.
patients.frontdesk: Find a patient quickly and confirm their details at the desk or on the phone.

visits.default: Start or continue a visit and write notes from anywhere.
visits.doctor: Open a visit, add your notes and close it between patients, no desktop needed.

prescriptions.default: Review and sign prescriptions as soon as they are ready.
prescriptions.doctor: Sign pending prescriptions in one tap instead of waiting until you are back at your desk.

labs.default: Get lab results and approve them without waiting.
labs.doctor: Review and approve results the moment they land, and act on the abnormal ones first.
labs.nurse: See which results are back so you can tell patients and prepare next steps.

vitals.default: Record blood pressure, pulse, temperature and more at the bedside.
vitals.nurse: Enter vitals at the bedside and get an immediate warning when a value is critical.
vitals.doctor: See and record vitals during the visit without asking someone to walk them over.
vitals.manager: Keep vitals recorded on time across the team.

homevisits.default: Plan your route, check in at each home and use the safety button on home visits.
homevisits.nurse: Follow your round, check in at every home and press the safety button if you ever feel unsafe.
homevisits.doctor: Run your home visits with route, check-in and a one-tap safety button.

revenue.default: See today's revenue and the last 7 days.
revenue.manager: Check today's and this week's revenue from your phone, wherever you are.

growth.default: Share your Kiorex link and QR code, and see which links bring patients.
growth.manager: See which links and Kiorex searches bring new patients, and what each costs you.
growth.doctor: Share your own Kiorex profile link and see how many patients it brings.

b2b.default: Refer a company that could offer its staff a Kiorex benefit.

rx.default: Verify prescriptions and see safety checks in one queue.
rx.pharmacist: Work the verification queue and see interaction and allergy checks before you dispense.

barcode.default: Scan any box to see price, stock and lots.
barcode.counter: Scan a box and answer a customer on price and stock without leaving the counter.

receiving.default: Scan deliveries against the purchase order.

stockcount.default: Count stock by scanning lots instead of writing it down.

expiry.default: See what is expiring or running low before it becomes a problem.
expiry.manager: Catch expiring and low stock early and avoid write-offs.
expiry.pharmacist: See which lots expire soon so you can rotate stock first.

controlled.default: Handle the controlled-drug register and witness countersigns.
controlled.pharmacist: Countersign controlled-drug movements from your phone instead of hunting for a colleague.
controlled.manager: See the controlled register balances and discrepancies at a glance.

shift.default: See your shift's sales and expected cash.
shift.counter: See your shift sales and expected cash before you count the drawer.
shift.manager: Check every shift's sales and expected cash without waiting for the end-of-day report.

orders.default: Get alerts for new Kiorex orders and respond on time.

growth.default: Share your Kiorex link and QR code, and see how many orders your own link brings.

phlebotomy.default: Scan labels and keep chain of custody on collection rounds.
phlebotomy.phleb: Scan every tube at the patient and keep the chain of custody without paper.

accession.default: Scan and receive specimens as they arrive.

critical.signatory: Acknowledge critical results and see escalations wherever you are.
critical.tech: Acknowledge a critical result the moment it is raised and see what happens next.
critical.manager: Make sure every critical value is acknowledged in time.

validation.signatory: Review and sign off results from your phone so reports are not waiting on you.
validation.tech: Technically validate results at the bench and move them on faster.

qc.default: See QC status and blocks before you run patients.
qc.tech: Check QC status and Levey-Jennings charts before you release a run.
qc.manager: See which analysers are blocked by QC without walking to the bench.

tat.manager: See which orders are about to breach their turnaround time and act before they do.

orders.default: Look up today's orders and their details.

reagents.tech: Know which reagents are low before a run fails.
reagents.manager: Reorder reagents before the bench runs out.

growth.default: Share your Kiorex link and QR code, and see how many bookings your own link brings.

pushPrompt.title: Stay on top of what matters
pushPrompt.body: Turn on notifications so Kiorly can reach you when something needs your attention. You can change this any time in Me.
pushPrompt.pointCritical: Critical alerts: safety and emergency events you must not miss.
pushPrompt.pointRx: Prescription events: new, signed or ready for dispensing.
pushPrompt.pointLab: Lab events: results ready and critical values.
pushPrompt.footnote: We only send work notifications. Nothing is sent without your permission.
pushPrompt.stateOn: On: critical alerts, Rx and lab events
pushPrompt.stateOff: Off. Turn on to get critical alerts, Rx and lab events
